digest.component_or_area: Bridge git delivery and push retry logic
propositions: Push operations fail on first transient transport error (TLS/DNS/timeout) with zero retries, abandoning converged reconcile work with unpushed commits
Transport failures and policy declines are classified identically as terminal, but policy declines are genuinely non-retriable while transport faults are retriable
Merge recovery fetch operations hit network during blob:none partial clones and fail terminally on transient errors, producing merge-recovery-blocked with no retry

Transport retry logic must distinguish retriable transient signatures (certificate verification, could-not-resolve-host, connection reset, timeout, RPC failure) from terminal policy violations via subtractive classification
Implementation requires relocating failure classification, backoff, and strict-reporting logic from push.py to new push_classify.py module to stay within 800-LOC hard cap
